markup.description: HTML/SVG markup for the 1280x720 stage. Give elements ids so draw(t) can address them.

css.description: Optional CSS for the markup. No @keyframes or transitions - all motion comes from draw(t).

js.description: Body of function draw(t) with t in [0,1]. Must be a pure function of t: no Date, no Math.random, no timers, no network.

caption.description: Optional short caption rendered under the stage.
